PLCMT_NEPTUNE_ARIES.core: Your Neptune in Aries means where you encounter mystery and dissolve boundaries is organized around action, will, and reimagining what courage means. Your generation dreams of radical autonomy. Neptune is the capacity for imagination and dissolution, and in Aries it operates through idealizing independence and questioning what assertion actually is. Your generation's dream is about perfect individuality. The collective longing is for courage that's both fierce and compassionate. You're wired to sense where will has become violence, where independence has hardened into isolation. The generational work is holding the vision of action that serves both self and whole.
PLCMT_NEPTUNE_ARIES.behavioral: You idealize independence, dream of perfect courage, and dissolve boundaries around what assertion means. When you're connecting to the mystery, it arrives through visions of radical autonomy or spiritual warriorship. Your confusion lives in the gap between ideal independence and the messiness of actual will. You're learning that the dream of perfect self-determination both inspires and deceives. This isn't just fantasy. It's genuine spiritual longing for action that's both powerful and humble. The shadow is that idealization can prevent real assertion. You may dream of courage without ever actually acting, or you may confuse spiritual bypassing with enlightened independence. The work is using your capacity to imagine new forms of will while remaining grounded in what actual courage requires.
